lede: The gondola replacement moves toward a critical deadline this week, with SMART needing $18 million committed by fall 2026 to secure federal funding. Mountain Village Council tackles an independent investigation report and votes on expedited affordable housing review policies. Meanwhile, Telluride's historic commission faces two projects staff recommend rejecting, and Norwood considers updating outdoor lighting standards.
